**Body:**

The Toronto Raptors in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #6 Kawhi Leonard 77.3
- #15 Scottie Barnes 65.8
- #63 Immanuel Quickley 56.1
- #79 Jakob Poeltl 53.8
- #97 RJ Barrett 52.4
- #172 Collin Murray-Boyles 45.9
- #200 Ja'Kobe Walter 44.1
- #228 Kyle Anderson 42.2

GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
